title: maleCNS-depth: pre-registration and analysis code for the certified information-breaking depth of the male Drosophila CNS connectome
description:
Results of the confirmatory analysis of a pre-registered study of the synapse-flow Markov chain of the male Drosophila central nervous system connectome (male-cns v1.0, FlyEM and collaborators, CC-BY).

The five pre-registered hypotheses were run once, on 26 September 2026, after the freeze release v0.2.0-frozen (doi:10.5281/zenodo.22981189); the pre-registration is the registration record v0.1.0-prereg (doi:10.5281/zenodo.22980248). Verdicts against the frozen criteria: H2 passed, H5 passed as a sensitivity result, H1, H3 and H4 failed. This release adds the logs, result files and RESULTS_2026-09-26.md.
